title: Juniper and the Aftermath
author: Rosalind Zhou
blurb: Marguerite Voss, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
